summary: Douglas County fire-patrol lookout near Riddle, built 1923, rebuilt 1942, torn down in June 2012 and replaced by a camera.

facts.design: log lookout house first; a 14x14 standard house on a tower from 1942 (28 ft in the 1942 report; firelookout.com gives 20 ft and calls it an L-4)
facts.status_note: Tower removed June 4, 2012 for advanced decay; a camera replaced it, per firelookout.com and a 2013 blog post

staffing.status: staffed every summer into the late 2000s, per firelookout.com

facts.agency: Douglas County Fire Patrol association, later the Douglas Forest Protective Association (Oregon Department of Forestry)

Quinlan Brown took up duties as lookout

lookout William Brown reported a 10:30 p.m. fire; the report calls it and a midnight fire from the year before incendiary

14x14 standard house on a 28-foot tower built, mostly by CCC crews; firelookout.com gives a 20-foot L-4

new-type lookout house roof installed at $428.53
tower removed June 4, 2012 for advanced decay; Oregon Department of Forestry replaced it with cameras

corrections.why: 7.6 m is 25 ft; the 1942 report gives a 28-foot tower and firelookout.com gives 20 ft, and 25 ft was only a 1937 recommendation

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A July 1923 newspaper item describes the station as established and under construction; firelookout.com dates the station to 1924. The story uses 1923 and notes the 1924 date.
The 1942 annual report gives a 28-foot tower; firelookout.com gives a 20-foot L-4. Height is left out of the facts.
A 1923 item places the site nine miles west of Riddle; a 1944 item places it southeast of Riddle. Both are quoted in the story.

notes_for_editor: Sources agree the tower was removed in June 2012 (1 and 3) and that cameras replaced it (2 and 3); no source describes the site today or whether it is public, so access is omitted. The FFLOS page at firetower.org (US 1091) is a Grant County Silver Butte in the Umatilla National Forest, not this Douglas County site, and must not be merged with us-or-silver-butte. The record coordinate (42.85893, -123.37834) is not checked against the conflicting Riddle directions (west in 1923, southeast in 1944). Height_m 7.6 is in the record but no source supports it, so it is proposed for removal.
